v3_positive_deltas: Caller-supplied relation, target-branch, winner and related target-like label fields are explicitly rejected.
Formal task-world test predictions plus observed outcomes mechanically derive SUPPORTS/COUNTERS/FALSIFIES and context applicability.
Derivation receipts bind world, state-before and event digests and declare caller relation fields unaccepted.
Exact event replay is idempotent; repeated correlation ancestry, payload identity and independence group remove independent evidence credit.
Projection is non-destructive; branch birth is possible only through formal-world birth rules; merging is exact formal semantic signature only.
Discriminator pair separation is mechanically derived from branch predictions rather than asserted pair lists.
Synthetic task-local resolution remains typed RESOLVED_WITHIN_SYNTHETIC_WORLD and mints no canonical truth/effect/runtime/training credit.

Mutation/property source tests now cover forged labels, outcome flips, replay, correlation ancestry, payload repackaging, projection, branch birth, exact merge, discriminator derivation, permutation/ID nuisance and epistemic UNKNOWN retention.

remaining_critical_gap.finding: The v3 event schema still requires caller-provided independence_qualified. The labeler correctly removes independent credit when exact-event, correlation-ancestry, independence-group or payload reuse is detected, but a novel event can still be declared independence_qualified=true without a source-bound generator/dependence certificate proving why that declaration is warranted.
remaining_critical_gap.why_it_matters: D/E supervision must teach evidence dependence semantics, not merely trust a generated boolean that names the desired property. Otherwise the label root moves from relation to independence and remains partially self-asserted.
remaining_critical_gap.required_repair: At the derivation-bound admission layer, derive or verify independence qualification from an immutable event/dependence registry or deterministic formal-world generator certificate. Reject free model/generator booleans as sufficient roots of independent-evidence credit.
remaining_critical_gap.counterhypothesis: The ancestry/group/payload collision checks are sufficient because independence_qualified is only an extra conservative flag.
remaining_critical_gap.reason: The false case is conservative, but the true case still authorizes independent evidence credit for an otherwise novel event. The project trains epistemic typing itself, so the positive independence claim must also have reproducible provenance.

gate_type_boundary.finding: Generic candidate gate v2 still permits SYNTHETIC_DETERMINISTIC_LABEL to satisfy generic hyperposition.resolution_status=RESOLVED_BY_EVIDENCE.
gate_type_boundary.required_successor_rule: Synthetic task resolution must live in the semantic-Hyperposition object as RESOLVED_WITHIN_SYNTHETIC_WORLD. Generic RESOLVED_BY_EVIDENCE remains reserved for admitted measured/verified causal evidence.
gate_type_boundary.why_model_training_cares: canonical_truth_allowed=false is not enough by itself; a model-visible/evaluator-visible epistemic type collapse would teach the wrong distinction even if runtime effect authority remains fenced.

training_data_disposition.next_regeneration_condition: one source-bound v3 derivation gate closes independence provenance + synthetic/causal resolution typing + nuisance gates
